Title: "Ocean's Murmurs"


Whale's song beneath waves,
Walnut's silence, firm and deep,
Nature's soft embrace.


This haiku captures the essence of the relationship between a whale and a walnut tree. "Whale's song beneath waves" evokes the grandeur of the marine world and the profound communication of the whale. In contrast, "Walnut's silence, firm and deep" conveys the steadfastness of the walnut tree, grounded in its silent wisdom. The final line, "Nature's soft embrace," unites these elements, suggesting a harmonious and intimate connection between the two, symbolized by the gentle and nurturing aspects of nature itself.

Title: "Silent Giants"

Nature's giants dream.

A gentle giant,

Silent Giants

The poem paints a picture of two elements of nature in dialogue, each significant in its own right, yet together they create a sense of unity and interconnectedness within the natural world.
